The alias regression rerun at seed 18606CAFE PASSED 1/1 with no skips; the reads assertion did not fail. Mechanism, traced in source at this head: without the guard, an alias probe reaches ZkStateReader.forceUpdateCollection, whose LazyCollectionRef fetch issues zkClient.getData on DocCollection.getCollectionPath(alias), a path that does not exist because an alias is not a collection; fetchCollectionState catches the NoNode and returns null, so the forced update ends without a successful read. The metrics listener (a JVM-wide static shared by all SolrZkClients, SolrZkClient.java:82) counts foreground getData traces (SolrZKMetricsListener), and no counted read materialized from the failed fetch. The counter itself is live, as the test's positive control shows (+1 for a deliberate successful getData, passing at both seeds at the head and inside the mutated run's own execution). Whether Curator emits no foreground trace for a failed getData, or the trace is emitted without incrementing, is not distinguishable from this evidence; either way the gate's anticipated case applies: metrics omit the failed getData operations the mutation adds, so the assertion cannot fail from them. Stability note the gate asked for: the metrics are shared across every client in the JVM, yet the exact-equality reads assertions were stable across all runs here (both seeds at head, and the mutated run); no unrelated-activity noise was observed in these runs. Conclusion: non-reproduction, reported per the gate; the mutation leg is not claimed as a pass, and the gate is therefore not filed passed.
